1. Introduction

"ShrimpFarm" is an Android management tool designed for shrimp farmers, providing feeding records, water quality management, pond inspection, feed mixing calculation, data analysis, backup, and more. This app is independently developed and operated by Xia Weibing.

We understand the importance of your personal information and are committed to protecting it. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use this app.

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully before using the app. If you do not agree with any term, please stop using the app. By using the app, you agree to all terms of this Privacy Policy.

2. Information We Collect

2.1 Information You Provide

When you register and use the account features, we collect the following information:

TypeContentPurpose
EmailEmail address you register withAccount registration, login, password recovery
PasswordLogin password you setAccount security (encrypted and sent to auth server)
NicknameDisplay name you chooseIn-app identity display
WebDAV credentialsWebDAV account and password you enterData backup to WebDAV service

2.2 Business Data Generated During Use

This app's core function is to record and manage various farming data entered by you, stored entirely on your device.

2.3 Device Information

Only device model and manufacturer are recorded in local crash logs, never uploaded. We do NOT collect ANDROID_ID, IMEI, MAC, geolocation, contacts, SMS, or camera data.

This app contains no ad SDKs or third-party tracking tools.

3. How We Use Information

Collected information is used solely for: account registration/login, in-app identity display, data backup/restore, and providing core farming management features.

4. Data Storage & Security

Farming data is AES-128 encrypted in local SQLite. Account info uses private SharedPreferences. Communications use HTTPS. Backup files are fully encrypted.

Data stays on your device until you delete the app. Backups kept up to 20 copies.

5. Sharing & Disclosure

We do not sell or rent your information. We may disclose when required by law or for service necessity (WebDAV backup, Supabase auth).

6. Network & Third-Party Services

Network used for: Supabase auth, WebDAV backup, GitHub Pages (market prices). All transmissions encrypted.

7. Your Rights

You have the right to access, rectify, delete your data, withdraw consent, and data portability via backup export.

8. Minor Protection

This app is intended for shrimp farming professionals, not minors under 14.

9. Policy Updates

We may update this policy. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
